notes.title: New languages added!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/cb72880955ae8e4af9c23d44b83104376e50f713.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

1) Brazilian Portuguese and Serbian languages added!
As some of you may know, we've launched Translate Blitzkrieg 3 Project on Crowdin in May 2017. With great help of our community base, we are now able to expand the list of languages supported.

[b]We would like to express our gratitude to:[/b]
- Andrei Soares Portes Machado for translating more than 50% of the text to Brazilian Portuguese.
- Goran Bošnjak, Dule Dudule, Goran Milinkov and Nikoladiv for contributing in Serbian translation!

Thank you so much for making these translations come true.

We hope that we will be able to bring Blitzkrieg 3 to even more languages. If you are interested in helping us and receiving some nice prizes for your contributions, please feel free to visit our Crowdin page: https://crowdin.com/project/blitzkrieg-3


[h1]Changes:[/h1]

1) Fight with Boris (as a separate game mode) is no longer available in Demo. 
Please remember that in the previous update we've introduced rating Boris in Multiplayer (Skirmish 1х1). These fights against him remain available and also provide you rating points and units for victories.

2) Reworked tutorial
Now it consists of one campaign mission, one side-mission and one tutorial Skirmish battle. Now you will be able to get to Multiplayer and other content of the game faster than before, learning about all the mechanics of the game in only 3 fights. 
Tutorial side-missions had been reworked to provide more information on how to play for the beginners.

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]

1) Graphics optimization improved. 
2) Several graphics issues solved.

notes.title: Changes in PvP!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/22a5629226a749187ded8cbc5489cd26b6db2723.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[b]- Boris in PvP Skirmish![/b]
Now, if the search for an opponent in Skirmish 1x1 is taking more than 2 minutes, you will be matched with Boris. But not a usual one. Winning over this Boris will provide you same rating points and rewards as if you were playing against a real player.

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]
- Fixed an issue which caused matchmaking to glitch (you could have picked your pool but you were not able to actually load to the fight).
- Fixed an issue due to which some of the players were not receiving rewards for battles in PvP modes.
- Minor localization fixes.
- Few terrain textures improvements.
- Optimization improvements.

notes.title: Changes in the Demo!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/3997d6a7f6b0ce2d45ca56cf20db7626c679b54b.jpg[/img]

[h1]What’s new:[/h1]

[b]1) Campaign missions are now available in the Demo![/b]
Before this patch you’ve been busy rising in rating. This allowed you to fight on other eras and expand your army. 
Now, rating is opening campaign missions too! 
This means that you will also be able to try a bit more of a PvE-part of the game before purchase :)

To unlock a mission, you need to receive a certain amount of rating points for fighting in Skirmish. This number corresponds to one of the 7 ranks in the game.
If your rating points number drops down, the mission will become unavailable again (even if you managed to play it before). 

Please remember that additional missions will remain inaccessible in the Demo. 

[b]2) Changes in the rating system[/b]
The amount of rating points received for victories and defeats has been increased threefold. This will allow Demo version players reach 2nd and 3rd eras faster and fight on them.

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]

1) Fixed a bug in Sevastopol mission which led to a freeze after certain actions and made the completion of the mission impossible;
2) Fixed a bug in March on Berlin due to which a defeat screen was shown after the final cutscene instead of a victory one;
3) Fixed several historical inaccuracies in Rebellion in Warsaw;
4) Corrected a few mistakes in English and German localizations.

notes.title: Technical Patch #14
Technical Patch #14
New mission!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/4888f2a3727dc00770ba2179f37c17cd31ad5ec2.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

[b]1) New Allies mission - "The Liberation of Paris"![/b]
In this scenario, you will fight for the liberation of the capital of France from the occupation of the Germans. You will lead the advanced Allied forces and send them into battle under the Eiffel Tower. There is a large camp of German troops nearby it. Your army is limited, but the rebellious Parisians are ready to fight for the liberation of their hometown by your side. Together, you will force German troops out of Paris!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/e658789406ecd172b1089977e4cd99e4752ed670.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/85fbd56f727011bd431f19f96369e1b95ef465a8.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/432f824f251d1c66d57d736b51bef6360257eb3c.jpg[/img]

[b]2) Added timers [/b]
(which show how much time is left before the units from reserve will appear on the battlefield)
Now it will be easy for you to see how many seconds it will take for the reserves to join the fight. This knowledge will allow you to perform better on the battlefields.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/e8e9349db4d75aad9c299f7dfb2c94ffe0abf52d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]

1) Fixed a number of issues which lead to disconnects (especially on the Asian servers).
2) Before, when you made a save, logged out of the game and turned it on again, the first thing you could see was a battle report where you saw you were defeated. You were able to load the game, still. Now, when you will enter the game while having a save, you will be asked if you want to load the save first.
3) When you fought on "Mountain waterfall" map on the 2nd era, you may have noticed that all guns on it were from era 3. Now all guns are from the same era you are playing on. 
4) Fixed victory screen on the "Border Town" map.
5) Fixed Rokossovsky's rewards for leveling up the reputation. Before, you were given era 3 tank for leveling the reputation to level 1 and could not use it right away due to it. Now you will receive era 1 tank for reaching level 1 with this commander.
6) Fixed a lot of issues and typos in game texts.

notes.title: Technical Patch №12
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/c0bf062f230b76fda062e9b400bdd410d2ae6680.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

[b]1) Rewind feature in missions[/b]
There were many comments left by Blitzkrieg 3 community members asking for an ability to speed up the units movement around the map. Your wish came true with this patch :)
Now you will be able to play on x2 speed. 
The rewind buttons can be found at the same place they are in Battle Replays:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/5c1fad371e5256daa32dbba36785583db795d405.jpg[/img]

[b]2) New PvP map[/b]
The new map is called "Mountain waterfall". Its main feature is two absolutely different neighboring climate zones. One side of the map is covered with snow, and the other one has already entered springtime. 
You can read more about it in our previous [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/235380/announcements/detail/1438193798259958962]Development blog[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/c92f22453f71d5191290b88cb49a5d544aecd2a1.jpg[/img]

[b]3) 7 new achievements added[/b]
All of the new achievements can be unlocked through completing the first missions of the game. Please note, that those of you, who have already completed them will have to replay them in order to receive new achievements.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/1fe9acd9161597f801e609980887bb88e08dda23.jpg[/img]

4) Reworked tutorial
All the tutorial texts have been rewritten in order to make the game more friendly and understandable for new users. Game tips are shown right over the reserve panel.

5) Added access to Demo through Launcher
Now everyone who is not using Steam to play will be able to play in the Demo too. 
What is more, Launcher users will soon become able to upgrade their Standard editions to Deluxe ones in Launcher. 

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]

1) Some of the reasons disconnects happened were eliminated.
2) Matchmaking search time had been improved. 
3) Some of the authorization issues were fixed.

1) Some of the reasons disconnects happened were eliminated.
2) Matchmaking search time had been improved.

notes.title: Translate Blitzkrieg 3!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/4eb7582a7df50bc8325cdbf01e4618c615a6828b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, officers!

In May 2017 Translate Blitzkrieg 3 Project was launched. 
Many of you have already participated in it and made a lot for making the game more interesting and understandable for other people around the world. 

Thanks to you, Polish, Czech and Ukrainian languages were added into the game. 
It is a huge step for Blitzkrieg 3, but there is still more that can be done.
 
There are dozens of languages in the world, and without you, translating Blitzkrieg 3 to them will remain a dream. 
Make it come true! 
Help others enjoy the game and receive valuable rewards for your efforts!

[h1]You can find the Translate Blitzkrieg 3 Project here:[/h1]
http://translate.blitzkrieg.com/project/blitzkrieg-3 
If you are willing to translate the game to any other language which is not represented on Crowdin's page - just write about this on any Blitzkrieg 3 social platform and it will be added right away!

[h1]All contributors (who will contribute a certain amount of words translated) will be able to receive:[/h1]
1) Blitzkrieg 3 Deluxe edition
2) Copies of Blitzkrieg 1 and Blitzkrieg 2
3) Packs of rare units

The most active participants will be awarded with exclusive Strategic edition of the game.
It was available only for a short amount of time in the beginning of development and includes exclusive content.

notes.title: Technical Patch №11
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/ebfcc6aa6c818f4a6f2bced2c1e4db3925586db3.jpg[/img]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
1. Implemented time indication to the game chat.

2. Now when we will be shutting our servers down for maintenance works, you will receive an ingame pop-up about it. 

3. Now you will be able to skip tutorial even without completing the first mission.

4. Redesigned Unit Info screen. 
Now it will be more comfortable for you to see all the characteristics at once. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/6df4cebefbe0793eba68d2ba1c85ee341ee06173.jpg[/img]

5. Added Ukranian localization!
Ukrainian translation was brought to you by STS UA members: Denys Nyzhnyk and Leonid Khlivnyuk!
We truly appreciate the dedication STS UA put into our game to help our Ukranian players experience the game in their native language. 

Please don't forget to check STS UA's page out: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=863457441 and shout out a big "Thank you" to them! :)

P.S. We are deeply interested in bringing Blitzkrieg 3 to as many languages as possible. You can participate in our translation project - http://translate.blitzkrieg.com/project/blitzkrieg-3, and help us and many other players enjoy the game on other languages. If your native language is not under one of the target languages under the project you can always suggest to the team to add more languages. We will gladly reward every solid contribution with Blitzkrieg franchise games, units and etc.!

6. Custom game and Battle reports have switched places.
Now Custom game can be found in the menu and Battle reports can be spotted on the globe.

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]
1. Optimised memory usage.
This should help prevent many cases when you could receive an "Oops! The game is crashed" error.

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/b27e1278a91785c1ce7e367ce3fede5b94d63365.png[/img]

Good day to you, recruits!

[h1]Today we are launching Blitzkrieg 3 Demo Version. [/h1]
Demo Version will allow you to experience many features from the full version to make up your mind about the game.

[h1][b]What is available in the Demo:[/b][/h1]

[h1]1) 21 full-blown missions (7 for each faction in the game) out of 68 available in full version[/h1]

[h1]2) Access to one of the game's PvP modes - Skirmish (1x1, 2x2 and 3x3)[/h1]
This classic to RTS mode is the only place where you will be able to receive rewards for winning. The only exception is rewards granted for completing missions. 

[h1]3) Full unit park of the game[/h1]
You will be able to command all units from the full version! To receive access to units from Era 2 and Era 3, you need to move up in our ranking system. You can receive new ranks through fighting in Skirmish battles.

[h1]4) Ability to fight versus Boris[/h1]
Boris is our neural artificial intelligence that learns from you, our players, on how to build his tactics! Boris is a very interesting enemy since he never plays the same, yet never uses any unfair information. He plays like a real player!
Please keep in mind that [b]in the Demo version you won't get any rewards for winning against him[/b]. But, through these fights, your units will gain experience and you will also get research points using which you will be able to improve your army. 

[h1]5) Custom game mode[/h1]
In Custom game you will be able to team up with those you want to play with and against with, choose the map you like to fight on and etc.

We hope that bringing up the [b]Demo Version[/b] will make you interested in the game. This is a great opportunity for you to try Blitzkrieg 3 out before purchasing. Try every aspect of the game: PvE, PvP, Boris and Custom game!

[i]Go through the legendary battles of Second World War and be victorious![/i]

notes.title: Technical Patch №10
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/a2be1b5d83a7603657ad33f11b3041dc1962351f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Fixed issues:[/b][/h1]

[h1][i]1. General:[/i][/h1]
1) Fixed Errorcode_invalidversion error.
2) Fixed Login as Username issue.
3) For some players loading of missions or PvP stuck on 50% sometimes. We got rid of this problem :)
4) Fixed an issue which made the "In Battle!" button work incorrectly sometimes.
5) Multiple sound errors fixed.
6) Lots of work put into the stabilization of the server connection, which should lead to visual improvement of loading times (missions, PvP, even replays), and lags and freezes should be appearing less often.
7) Fixed an issue due to which units were coming in as reserves not in from maximum to minimum level order, but in a random one.

[h1][i]2. PvE[/i][/h1]
1) In "An unexpected encounter" mission the priority of tasks has been changed.
2) Fixed the issue with infantry units lost counter in "Operation Compass".
3) Fixed an error due to which if you've lost in the second part of the "March on Berlin" mission, "Epilogue", you were automatically brought back to the globe.
4) Fixed a bug in "Operation Dragoon" due to which the coastal gun could not shoot where you pointed it to.
5) Fixed an error due to which if you loaded a save made on the second part of the "March on Berlin" mission you could not receive an achievement for completing USSR campaign. 

[h1][i]3. PvP[/i][/h1]
1) Now if you somehow got disconnected from skirmish battle and reconnected to the game, you won't be considered a loser and be able to play further. 
2) Fixed an issue due to which all filter set up in Custom game got lost if you clicked on "Update" button.
3) Now, users, which are in a squad, can not fight in different battles at a time.
4) Fixed an issue due to which a player which did not take his place in a Custom game lobby could not join any other lobby later.

[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
1) Now, when fighting versus AI, the side your units will be spawned at will be randomly assigned.
2) The timer was removed at the screen of choosing which units to be taken to battle vs Boris.
3) Characteristics of Sd.Kfz.231. have been changed.

notes.title: New Skirmish map!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/ca1fcd0cb3df7664e0bbab1ed5ff2beaa5b6074f.jpg[/img]

Greetings, officers!

[h1]We are happy to announce that we've added a new Skirmish map to the game![/h1]

[b]The map is called "Normandy coast". [/b]
As it follows from its name, you are going to fight on the beautiful shore of the ocean on the north of France.  Fierce fights have already taken their toll on these territories, as evidenced by fallen aircraft and sunken ships. But the war is not over yet.

On this map, one side will receive reinforcements from the ground, and the other from the sea. A long line of coastal defence lies between you and your opponent, where two irreconcilable forces clashed in battle previously. Do not let the efforts of your comrades be wasted!

There are lots of pillboxes and anti-aircraft guns left on the battlefield by enemy and allies which you can use to your advance. Moreover, you can find as many as 6 howitzers on the map, the capture of which will provide you tactical superiority.

[b]This map is available only for 1x1 Skirmish battles at the moment. [/b]
In the foreseeable future, you will be able to play on it in the 2x2 and 3x3 Skirmish modes.

[i]Hope to see you soon on the new battlefield![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/36b0d00e464bedc73ba8478cfcd6a0af6f45fe49.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 3 new missions!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/57319ff32827bac7ecdbef9cab162dbfd6a8c1d3.png[/img]

Good day to you, officers!

[h1]THREE new missions are waiting for your attention [b]right now[/b]![/h1]
What is more, these PvE scenarios are the first ones to have our neural artificial intelligence, [b]Boris[/b], as an opponent in them!

Boris is an interesting and dangerous enemy. He analyses each battle he fought to improve his strategy and plays differently all the time. 

Look for “Dunkirk”, “Operation Dragoon” and “Breakthrough in the desert” on the globe. In the first two missions, you will fight for the Allies, and in the last one – for Germany.

To arouse the interest in these missions, here goes their description! 

[h1]1) Dunkirk[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/0af0b47e18a97993cced794a1688a9537f09df14.png[/img]

After the breakthrough of the Maginot line on May 10, 1940, German command developed its success by blocking the Allied forces near the city of Dunkirk. It was time for the Allied forces to evacuate from the area - there was no chance to win or to launch an offensive against the troops of the Axis.
Thousands of British soldiers and their allies are now trapped on the banks of the English Channel. The trap of the Germans is ready to shut and murder many people. But the ships are ready to transfer the soldiers, and all they need is a cover.

You are the one responsible for providing support for the retreating soldiers and minimize Allied losses. The Salvation of those who will become the backbone of the Allied forces in the future rests on your shoulders.

[h1]2) Operation Dragoon[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/c571f977c054e0fa71fe6e9fdd30b37e2cb4f77a.png[/img]

Operation Dragoon or Operation Anvil is one of the most glorious operations Allied forces had ever had. With minimum losses, Allies were able to free the south of France from the German occupation in a month. 

On the 15h of August landing on the coast between Toulon and Cannes began. The goal your special forces are up to is to seize Marseille, a large seaport of a significant strategic importance.

Enemy forces did not have time to complete the construction of defensive structures, but the port and its harbor are covered with 280mm coastal guns fire. You have to break through the defense of the Germans and capture their coastal battery. This will help your troops to hold out until the reinforcements necessary for the liberation of the city arrive.

[h1]3) Breakthrough in the desert[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/e13d3d42837d5c6a7b292d1a67f62e325c29d4a3.jpg[/img]

During their offensive in North Africa, the Allied troops reached German supply line near El Alamein. It is vitally important to stop them and keep this sector under control: if your troops cannot hold the attack of the Allies, Axis countries’ army will find themselves without ammunition and provisions, without an ability to fight. Don’t let this happen – stand your ground till the very end!

[i]See you on the battlefields!
We hope that you will enjoy the new missions :)[/i]

Look for “Dunkirk”, “Operation Dragoon” and “Breakthrough in the desert” on the globe. In the first two missions, you will fight for the Allies, and in the last one – for Germany.

To arouse the interest in these missions, here goes their description! 

[h1]1) Dunkirk[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/0af0b47e18a97993cced794a1688a9537f09df14.png[/img]

After the breakthrough of the Maginot line on May 10, 1940, German command developed its success by blocking the Allied forces near the city of Dunkirk. It was time for the Allied forces to evacuate from the area - there was no chance to win or to launch an offensive against the troops of the Axis.
Thousands of British soldiers and their allies are now trapped on the banks of the English Channel. The trap of the Germans is ready to shut and murder many people. But the ships are ready to transfer the soldiers, and all they need is a cover.

You are the one responsible for providing support for the retreating soldiers and minimize Allied losses. The Salvation of those who will become the backbone of the Allied forces in the future rests on your shoulders.

[h1]2) Operation Dragoon[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/c571f977c054e0fa71fe6e9fdd30b37e2cb4f77a.png[/img]

Operation Dragoon or Operation Anvil is one of the most glorious operations Allied forces had ever had. With minimum losses, Allies were able to free the south of France from the German occupation in a month. 

On the 15h of August landing on the coast between Toulon and Cannes began. The goal your special forces are up to is to seize Marseille, a large seaport of a significant strategic importance.

Enemy forces did not have time to complete the construction of defensive structures, but the port and its harbor are covered with 280mm coastal guns fire. You have to break through the defense of the Germans and capture their coastal battery. This will help your troops to hold out until the reinforcements necessary for the liberation of the city arrive.

[h1]3) Breakthrough in the desert[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/e13d3d42837d5c6a7b292d1a67f62e325c29d4a3.jpg[/img]

During their offensive in North Africa, the Allied troops reached German supply line near El Alamein. It is vitally important to stop them and keep this sector under control: if your troops cannot hold the attack of the Allies, Axis countries’ army will find themselves without ammunition and provisions, without an ability to fight. Don’t let this happen – stand your ground till the very end!

[i]See you on the battlefields!
We hope that you will enjoy the new missions :)[/i]

notes.title: Technical patch №9
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/54d301d2fa17c6a96d4114a5403971c460446dc5.jpg[/img]

[h1]What’s new:[/h1]
1. We are introducing [b]rank system[/b] into the game!
Ranks demonstrate your battle efficiency. You can level it up both in PvE and PvP. The higher your rank is, the more modern units you will receive for the wins. 
This way, as soon as you unlock the Frontline and win a certain amount of times, you will be able to collect the whole unit park of the game and fight on other eras without completing the missions at all!
Receiving new ranks will also provide you an ability to purchase upgrades for your units (all eras upgrades included) in the Research tab whatever your campaign progression is. 

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
1. Now if you click on your nickname while being on the globe you will be able to see a Player Information screen.
There you can find your current rank, see the next one and learn what you must do to achieve it. Also, Leaderboard had been transferred to this screen.
Through pulling your cursor over the next rank you will be able to see which units will be available for dropping down as rewards after you receive it through fighting in PvP or completing a certain mission. 
2. Enhanced the sorting system of the reserves on the globe.

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]
1. Fixed a bug which caused units to behave incorrectly – some of them did not turn to the target, some didn’t shoot.
2. Aviation you called in is no longer is in flames from the start :)
3. Changed Pz II Luhs gun characteristics slightly.

notes.content:

[h1]Loading:[/h1]
1) Fixed a bug which, after loading some saved missions, caused the mission to load on a black screen and required players to press the Spacebar to continue the game.
2)  Fixed the problem that sometimes didn't allow saves made in the "Siege of Sevastopol" mission to load.

2) Fixed a bug that caused the animated movement of camels to malfunction.
3) A mistake with the American flag was corrected in the "Warsaw Uprising" mission.

4) Fixed a bug in the "Operation Archery" mission that caused the task to be completed when troops were called up from reserves.
5) Fixed a bug that didn't apply the "Improved shell ballistics" improvement to the Cruiser Mk.I tank's characteristics.

notes.title: Blitzkrieg 3 released!
notes.content:
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/release/gif.gif[/img]

[i]Dear players,[/i]

[h1]With your help the development of the main part of the game has come to an end. We are pleased to announce that today, June 2, we are celebrating the long-awaited release of Blitzkrieg 3! And we’ve got you to thank for it![/h1]

Many innovations, such as trenches, mobile fortifications and various technologies, were implemented based on your requests. These solutions allowed us to preserve the atmosphere of the original series. More than 90 new units have appeared during the early access stage, and most of them were your ideas.

The team wants to give special thanks to the players who painstakingly studied historical publications and documents. You’ve helped us achieve a very high level of historical authenticity: your recommendations and comments allowed us to correct more than 800 inaccuracies in graphics, characteristics and balance. Without your help, this would be impossible even with the involvement of historical consultants. 

Your ideas and desire to have a worthy and, most importantly, fair computer opponent prompted us to create Boris, the world's first neural network artificial intelligence for RTS.

Please note that on 1st of June we’ve reset the progress of all accounts.You can now fully appreciate all the numerous innovations and complete all 3 campaigns while enjoying their full-featured final versions, updated graphics and voice-over.

It is also very important for the players to be on an equal footing at the start of the project. Everyone will start from scratch. The outcome of battles will be determined by tactics rather than an endless reserve of machinery! However, your previous experience will undoubtedly become an advantage.
The game’s development does not stop there, and all your wishes and comments are still very important for the Blitzkrieg 3 team and will be taken into account when developing the game further!

Do not hesitate to use any of the available channels to contact us.
[b]The release of Blitzkrieg 3 is our unite victory, friends![/b]

[i]Sincerely,
Blitzkrieg 3 development team[/i]

[h1][b]Changes in the game:[/b][/h1]

1. Rewards for winning battles against artificial intelligence, Boris, have been added.

2. Added an icon on the globe by clicking on which you will be able to enter the battle against Boris.
 
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/node.png[/img]

3. New mission for the Allies added - "Harborage"!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/d9a0202318087a4f2726fcbd63f424dc85f230bc.jpg[/img]

April 1945. Intelligence reports that the German command had evacuated a part of its nuclear program, including scientists and developments, to the south of Germany. You, as the commander of the US special forces, are instructed to act in any country, including foreign ones. Find and take out all the documents, prototypes and nuclear materials you can find, and destroy those you are not able to collect. When the war comes to its end, this sector will be under French's control and we can not allow France, other countries of the coalition and especially Communists lay their hands on these technologies. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/5d86343ef360e74af5eb4fd6753ca0ee881207ec.jpg[/img]

Mission's special feature is the entry of your troops into a radioactive zone in which infantry and vehicles' crews can receive a large dose of radiation and die if you do not leave the dangerous territory in time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/aa2f410390928ad73caa47f2759f4a4b91157c59.jpg[/img]

4. Reworked "March on Daugavpils" mission.
Balance has been improved, task considering capturing the headquarters changed, several minor bugs fixed.

5. Changed icons marking units characteristics in the information about unit screen to new ones. 

6. Added Polish and Czech localization. 
 

[h1][b]Fixed issues:[/b][/h1]

1. Fixed several optimization issues. Loading time reduced, FPS ratio improved. Please keep in mind that we will keep working in this direction even after this patch! :)

2. Fixed issues causing the loading  of the game and missions to stuck. 

3. Fixed a number of issues which prevented people from playing in Custom game rooms and joining battles. 

4. Fixed a bug which added an extra T-34 to your Assault Group in "Operation in Messina" mission. 
 

[h1][b]Known issues:[/b][/h1]

1. Saves in "Harborage" mission are not working properly.

2. Skirmish 2x2 and 3x3 modes are temporarily blocked. Don't worry, they will be back!

notes.title: Technical patch №4
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/d7ee9dc7e2d994b141f15400fec0e038c32a5039.jpg[/img]

[h1]New features:[/h1]
New detailed characteristics have been added to the unit information screen. Now you are able to see how achieveing levels and reseaching unit enhancements affects unit's characteristics.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/c47febe3c6b54b3cb4d3f3b0d7f8661e2ce20ef9.jpg[/img]
[i](in order to see the picture in full size click on it using RMB and choose the first option in the list)[/i]

[h1]Fixed issues:[/h1]
1) Corrected the display of heatlh/armor characteristic on the globe.
2) Fixed and issue due to which "Hold fire" order on the command panel did not work correctly when used on infantry hiding in trenches.
3) Fixed the display of save complete message when the game is on pause. 
4) Display of units' fire range had been fixed. Previously it could have go over the minimap's borders. 
5) Closing the chat while gathering up your Attack Group is now working correctly.
6) Characteristics affected by commander's bonuses are now displayed the way they should be displayed.
7) Fixed a matchmaking issue in PvP modes.
8) Now the reserve panel won't close up when the unit you called in arrives to the battlefield.
9) Fixed most of the mobile fortifications animations.
10) Fixed several issues in workshop enhancements.
11) Fixed the issue which prevented AI in Base Assault from attacking a group of mobile fortifications with howitzer salvo.
12) Now you are able to leave the maintenance works screen without any problems through clicking on the cross on that screen.

notes.title: Technical patch №3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/fb3b655178f85ac235979f9266726274e513df94.png[/img]

[h1][b]In the technical patch following changes have been implemented:[/b][/h1]

1) You are now able to transfer your units from reserve to the Attack Group (while preparing to battle) using single mouse button click.
2) Now you can cancel your reinforcements 'call. To make so, you need to click on the unit which is on its way already and it won't arrive to the battlefield.
3) Added a screen where you need to confirm your wish to go from the globe to the Base.
4) Added research points counter to the end of the battle screen. Now you are able to see how much of them did you gain for each mission/fight.
5) Game session has been optimised. For example, buildings are now shown correctly while the fog is on the battlefield. 
6) Added sound effect connected to usage of commands on the command panel. 
7) Added new info screens which will provide description on the error you may possibly meet. For example, this screen may tell you that the error encountered was a connection error, not a game one. 
8) Text describing objectives completion on the victory screen color has been changed to white.
9) Changed icons of the upgrades in the Workshop. 


[h1][b]Technical issues:[/b][/h1]

1) Fixed the matchmaking issue which made a player who reached 3rd era who played through the Frontline on 1st era fight an opponent on 3rd era maps with 3rd era units. Now you will fight on 1st era :)
2) Now Research Points are given for victories in AI's base defence (When you are offline, AI is defending your Base. If it had it success and the attacker failed, you will receive Research Points!).
3) Fixed the display of arrows in the Workshop screen. 
4) Fixed the pop-ups with text descriptions of avia-supports on the globe and in battles.
5) 3 era USSR anti-aircraft fortification is displayed correctly now.
6) Fixed a bug because of which the log of events from the Base went into missions and multiplayer.
7) Removed the timer from the modes "Skirmish 2х2" and "Skirmish 3х3".

Now the units you selected on the screen with mission description will go in the battle with you, not the other ones :)

5) Fixed visibility of an anti-aircraft gun in Siege of Sevastopol. Now it is easy to spot and with that, possible to complete the mission without loosing several troops to its fire. 

6) Fixed a bug in Workshop for the German faction which made it impossible to buy upgrades for StuG and Nashorn. Now you can purchase them and continue upgrading your units.

notes.title: Update 0.9.10
notes.content:
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/GIF1.gif[/img]

Good evening, officers!

A lot of interesting things await you in the [b]0.9.10 [/b]update. Most of the things we’ve added to the game this time were requested by our community. In this post, we’ll briefly tell you about the latest game changes. Click on a specific topic to learn more. Here we go!

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/EN_1.png[/img]
You’ve been asking for them. You’ve been waiting for them. And they’re finally here! Based on the numerous requests of fans of the previous parts of the game, as well as fans of military strategies in general, we’ve introduced the ability to move the artillery. You will now be able to control mobile howitzers, anti-tank guns and AA guns. They are available in the game as separate units. You can add them to your assault group or use them as reinforcements. 
If the crew using the fortification is killed, it can be occupied by either your forces or the enemy. 
Mobile artillery can be entrenched. In this position, it loses the ability to move in exchange for increased defense of the gun and the crew. Bear in mind that the entrenched artillery has a limited barrel rotation range, so use this ability wisely to defeat the enemy.
Mobile artillery has low maneuverability, but, similar to infantry, units of this type are disguised when they enter forested areas.

Animation of shooting in many mobile fortifications is not in the final quality.

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/EN_2.png[/img]
The next important innovation is a Workshop for units. You’ll be able to improve your tanks, infantry, weapons and even air support using the latest engineering developments. 

Upgrades can be unlocked using research points. You receive research points for battles - the longer you fight and the more efficient you are, the more points you’ll get. 

You need to complete [b]missions[/b] in order to receive research points for them. The command will reward you with engineering resources for successful operations. Note that research points are awarded only [b]one time[/b]!

You receive points differently in [b]PvP[/b] mode. Points are awarded depending on the damage ratio and time spent in battle. Thus, you may receive almost nothing if your opponent is disconnected from the game or if you don’t perform any actions. Be more active! :)

Note that you [b]will not receive research points[/b] for battles arranged through the lobby, including battles against our AI, Boris. 
 
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/EN_3.png[/img]
Many of you who have already advanced to the second and third eras want to fight in the eras you have already completed. You will now have this opportunity! 

Previously, when you entered a new era your base moved with you and you couldn’t return to the previous era. You will now have a base at each phase of the war. You’ll be able to switch between them by changing the era. Each base will need to be equipped and defended, as the success of its defense will affect your rating. Your forces will be restricted to the era you are in and, as a consequence, you will not be able to assign a unit from the third era to protect a base from the second. 

And so, you will be able to play in Assault and Skirmish modes in any of your available eras. 

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/EN_4.png[/img]
[h1][b]March on Berlin[/b][/h1]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/Berlin.png[/img]
The mission takes place in April 1945. Soviet troops are approaching Berlin from the east, encircling the city. According to intelligence reports, to the west of Berlin a large grouping of troops is trying to break free of the encirclement.

Your mission is to locate and attack the group of German troops ready to break through to the west, where, according to intelligence, there are Nazi criminals. You need to provoke them into attack, keep them busy, and hold the western area until the allied forces close the encirclement from the north and south.

[h1][b]V-2[/b][/h1]
While working on the game, we came to the decision that Deluxe edition owners should have an additional mission for each faction. You have probably already managed to complete one such mission for Germany - Dora. V-2 is a deluxe mission for the USSR.

According to our intelligence, the Germans are testing the latest V-2 rockets at the firing area near Debits. We must capture one of these rockets at any cost!

[h1][b]"Monkey temple" - New Map for Skirmish Mode [/b][/h1]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/hram1.png[/img]
You will be fighting in the Malaysian jungle in a picturesque locale, where many waterfalls roar. The control points on this map are located in a peaceful village, in rice fields, and near an ancient temple. Combat operations were conducted in this area, and so part of the land has been mercilessly charred. But this doesn’t overshadow the jungle’s natural beauty. A feature of the map’s landscape is the abundance of areas covered by water, where passage through it will take longer than through land.

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/EN_5.png[/img]
[h1][b]UI and graphics:[/b][/h1]
1. [b]Globe icons have been changed[/b]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/metki.png[/img]
As you already know, there are several types of missions in the game. We’ve slightly adjusted the look of icons on the globe, and we hope that you will like these changes.

There are two types of missions in the game.
Large icons indicate missions that unlock access to the next phases of the war. Small icons indicate side missions. The color of the mission reflects its difficulty relative to the forces at your command. The icon disappears once the mission has been completed. The shield icon marks your base, where you have to place your troops to defend against assaults.To head into battle against other players, click on the icon with two crossed guns.
 
2. [b]Interface elements have been redesigned[/b]
Changes apply to:
• mission description window (including text);
• window that shows information about your unit;
• window that opens when you place your cursor on a unit;
• now negative effect timers are displayed above units and on the central panel;
• a reload timer has been added for slow-shooting units. 

3. [b]Some weather effects in the game have been redesigned. [/b]

[h1][b]Missions and maps[/b][/h1]
1. Tutorial has been updated and improved.
2. Side mission maps have been improved as well.
3. Maps that house first-era bases, which you can also see in Assault mode, have been redesigned.
4. The "Swamp" and "Ravine" maps have been moved to other eras:
•	"Swamp" has moved to the first era;
•	"Ravine" has moved to the second era.

[h1][b]Technical details: [/b][/h1]
1. The game now loads much faster. 
2. You can now disable voice notifications in the sound settings.
3. You can now select an era in the lobby. 
If you choose, for example, the second era, you can use units only from the first and second eras, etc.
4. We’ve solved problems with the launch of some missions in the Mac version of the game. 

[h1] [b]Known problems:[/b][/h1]
 1. Some images added in this update will be changed or improved.

According to our intelligence, the Germans are testing the latest V-2 rockets at the firing area near Debits. We must capture one of these rockets at any cost!

[h1][b]"Monkey temple" - New Map for Skirmish Mode [/b][/h1]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/hram1.png[/img]
You will be fighting in the Malaysian jungle in a picturesque locale, where many waterfalls roar. The control points on this map are located in a peaceful village, in rice fields, and near an ancient temple. Combat operations were conducted in this area, and so part of the land has been mercilessly charred. But this doesn’t overshadow the jungle’s natural beauty. A feature of the map’s landscape is the abundance of areas covered by water, where passage through it will take longer than through land.

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/EN_5.png[/img]
[h1][b]UI and graphics:[/b][/h1]
1. [b]Globe icons have been changed[/b]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines2104/metki.png[/img]
As you already know, there are several types of missions in the game. We’ve slightly adjusted the look of icons on the globe, and we hope that you will like these changes.

There are two types of missions in the game.
Large icons indicate missions that unlock access to the next phases of the war. Small icons indicate side missions. The color of the mission reflects its difficulty relative to the forces at your command. The icon disappears once the mission has been completed. The shield icon marks your base, where you have to place your troops to defend against assaults.To head into battle against other players, click on the icon with two crossed guns.
 
2. [b]Interface elements have been redesigned[/b]
Changes apply to:
• mission description window (including text);
• window that shows information about your unit;
• window that opens when you place your cursor on a unit;
• now negative effect timers are displayed above units and on the central panel;
• a reload timer has been added for slow-shooting units. 

3. [b]Some weather effects in the game have been redesigned. [/b]

[h1][b]Missions and maps[/b][/h1]
1. Tutorial has been updated and improved.
2. Side mission maps have been improved as well.
3. Maps that house first-era bases, which you can also see in Assault mode, have been redesigned.
4. The "Swamp" and "Ravine" maps have been moved to other eras:
•	"Swamp" has moved to the first era;
•	"Ravine" has moved to the second era.

[h1][b]Technical details: [/b][/h1]
1. The game now loads much faster. 
2. You can now disable voice notifications in the sound settings.
3. You can now select an era in the lobby. 
If you choose, for example, the second era, you can use units only from the first and second eras, etc.
4. We’ve solved problems with the launch of some missions in the Mac version of the game. 

[h1] [b]Known problems:[/b][/h1]
 1. Some images added in this update will be changed or improved.

notes.title: Tutorial added!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/cd23659eb85044b54f92fc2a0e8b0ceeb30a5f00.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changes in the game:[/h1]
1) You can now complete a [b]tutorial[/b] for each faction at the start of the game. It will help new users familiarize themselves with the basic mechanics and quickly get a feel for the game. This option won’t be offered to players who have already completed the starting missions for each of the factions. 

2) [b]2 new side missions for the Allies were added:[/b]

[i]1. Photo hunt [/i]
July 1943. After the Allies landed in Sicily, the Italians began to evacuate important military installations onto the mainland. Our scout plane was able to take photos of the Italian ports and nearby enemy forces, but on the way back, the scout plane and its escort were shot down. Your mission: find the crash site of the scout and retrieve the photos.

[i]2. Silent incursion[/i]
In the fall of 1944, the Allied forces liberated most of France, but the Germans still would not retreat. There are large clusters of Axis forces in the area where you are about to conduct an operation. Fortunately, the groups of troops are divided and we have a chance to deal with them separately. If you manage to hold onto victory, you will soon be able to completely neutralize the enemy in this region. 

3) The sandy map [b]"Desert port" [/b] for Skirmish mode is available again.

4) Owners of the deluxe edition of the game can now get a reward for winning in battles - [b]M6A2E[/b].

[h1]Technical details:[/h1]
1) The system for sound notifications about important events has been improved. 
2) A lock is now shown over the units that can’t be taken with you in certain missions.
3) Obstructions are no longer marked on the minimap, and their health points are not displayed either. 
4) Missions and PvP battles download faster now.
5) Two types of avia supports were strengthened:
- Significantly reduced smoke screen latency. Now it is on the battlefield almost instantly.
- Increased view radius for reconnaissance aircraft.

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
1) Skirkish modes 2x2 and 3x3 may not work correctly. 
2) Custom game may not work properly.

notes.title: 9 new missions added!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/3cd6e3343bb8933dbf51de99ed848942fb263cfd.jpg[/img]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines/1_EN.png[/img]
We have introduced tips in the first missions - buttons, icons, and areas are highlighted to help newcomers find their way around faster.
[b][img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines/2_EN_site.png[/img][/b]
9 new missions were added!

[h1]1. Failure of attack[/h1]
In this mission, you must destroy the enemy’s huge ammo depot to ensure a successful offensive on the front.
[h1]2. Desert base[/h1]
In this mission, your objective is to capture a German base that has great strategic importance. There are several checkpoints on its approach routes that won’t be easy to pass. Beware of enemy aircraft!
[h1]3. On the approach routes to the city[/h1]
German troops have firmly dug in and are operating under aircraft cover. You must break through the opposition and free the city from occupation.
[h1]4. Operation in Messina[/h1]
Your objective is to reach the German command headquarters, where a high-ranking officer is now. You must capture him and take him to the command headquarters to give a statement. 
[h1]5. Rescue operation[/h1]
One of the allied special groups was able to obtain important intelligence, but the group was discovered. The opposition is keeping the soldiers in a bunker in the interior of the island. They won’t hold out for long! You must rescue them and deliver the intel to the commander.
[h1]6. Battle of Aachen[/h1]
At a break in the Siegfried Line, your army stumbled upon a heavily fortified site in the Aachen area. Fierce fighting is taking place on the approach routes to the city. Despite this, your special group managed to get into the city. Now you have to secure your positions.
[h1]7. Yelnya Offensive[/h1]
In this mission, your objective is use a tactical ploy to lure the enemy away from the town and toward our minefields. Then force the weakened garrison out of the town.
[h1]8. Easy prey[/h1]
December 1941, Libya. A British offensive runs along the entire front line. Combined units from Australia, Greece and Great Britain are pushing the German divisions toward Tobruk. Your mission is to break through to the German outpost, capture it, and hold it until reinforcements arrive.
[h1]9. Firestorm[/h1]
In early August, 1942 Goth’s tank army performed an intense march and flanked Soviet troops to the southwest of Stalingrad. Command has decided to ambush it with Katyusha mortars near the Abganerovo train station. Your mission is to provide cover for the Katyushas and, with their help, stop the German assault.
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines/3_EN_site.png[/img]
A map for Skirmish Mode, "Port in the desert," was added! You will find out more about it in a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/235380/announcements/detail/254855148660363689]separate news post[/url]. 
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines/4_Site.png[/img]
New units were added for Deluxe edition owners.
You can get a hold of them, like with any other unit, by fighting in PvE and PvP.
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines/5_EN_site.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]Improved synchronization: downloading and updating players’ readiness status will go a little faster.
[*]The "Army Reserve" window in the battle is now automatically hidden if the player gives an order or clicks an object on the battlefield.
[*]Support on the globe was moved to the right side of the screen.
[*]The display of infantry units in homes was modified.
[*]Icons for effects from vehicles and the forest were modified.
[*]A number of bugs were fixed. [/olist]
 [img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/Lines/6_EN_site.png[/img]
[olist]
[*]The [i][b]"reconnection"[/b][/i] function was added. If a user loses connection with the game, he/she can return to the battle within 2 minutes (for PvP) or continue gameplay from the moment of the disconnection.
[*]Voicing of important events in the game was added. For example, "Your troops were attacked" and "Enemy aircraft spotted."
[*]The ability "Throw anti-tank grenade" was added for the assault infantry.
[*]In PvE missions, the number of reinforcement points for the missions are now displayed.
[*]In the window for the commander’s rewards, the units that you already received for moving up a level and the reward for subsequent levels are now displayed.[/olist]


[b]Known issues:[/b]
1. If you reconnect, the game may struggle upon loading the client after ending up a skirmish match. But don't worry - all the rewards and the raiting points will be added correctly. 
2. There may be problems with registration in 2x2 and 3x3 skirmish modes.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366650/

notes.title: Rewards for Talented Commanders!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/b017a229369714adbf195e5ba1d09550f973561b.png[/img]

Greetings, officers!

[h1]Since the new map for Skirmish Mode is coming out, we’ve prepared an excellent opportunity for you to add units to your vehicle fleet by completing one simple objective![/h1]

All players who can [b]win[/b] in Skirmish Mode (that includes winning 1x1, 2x2, and 3x3 matches) on [b]February 23rd[/b] will receive a set of units as a reward:

•	First era unit: Valentine Mk.IX
•	Second era unit: PzKpfw VI Tiger
•	Third era unit: T-44

[h1]Attention! 
Completing the objective again will not earn you additional rewards. 
[/h1]

The rewards will be distributed during the week after the end of the event. 
[b]The units will be awarded again after the wipe on the release of the game. [/b]

Good luck on the battlefield!

notes.title: New Skirmish map!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/d9ae79b99aa0e82aac4a1bf465f9bc34fbb1ab6f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The February 22nd update will thrill players with a new map for Skirmish Mode that allows you to battle in the desert.[/h1]
There are several interesting places to discover on this map.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/772c51b56fb1b96ef7056a55fede8ab34cc9faf8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Let’s start by taking a look at the traditional three control points. [/h1]
One of them is at the port, which has a picturesque view of the sea.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/823d3d2ca81c17a953b6576e94b8a8f51aad5d89.jpg[/img]

The other two are located near cities to the north and south of the map. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/29603259483c5eabc2d0f277e06372a4ce361256.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/1ad08116414a97a54953e2147c5d1aa15a24425d.jpg[/img]

Between them is a city with beautiful minarets surrounded by gardens. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/35f57242cea82fef22178983d1c857b141ffce7e.jpg[/img]

[i]This map has endless points of interest![/i]
You can ambush the enemy by the railroads and rail station, by the small lakes, or by the oil warehouse, which we strongly suggest blowing up. :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/f730b4dbab55136860ea87ff5453cd115984a1e0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Share your impressions of the new map in the comments![/h1]

notes.title: 7 new missions added!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/429c47926855c71eadcd06c1167b48f976c02f84.jpg[/img]

1. Now your friends in Steam will be automatically added to your friends list in the game.

2. Black list added – players on the black list will not be able to send you messages, invite you to their squads or add you as a friend.

6. Fixed the bug that caused Wirbelwind to shoot incorrectly.

7. New Year’s support and map events have been removed from the game.

8. Fixed a number of issues related to game saves and their loading.

9. Fixed the bug which made chat pop out after you pause the game.

notes.title: Duel with friends!
notes.content:
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/lobby.gif[/img]

 
[h1]Greetings, comrades! [/h1]

 Version 0.9.6. has impressed players with a new play  mode – Custom Game. It's  a great opportunity to find out which players are stronger in private fights.  And Custom Game will help strategy experts test experimental tactics! You can  play with your friends in teams of up to 3 people, or wage war against each  other in individual combats. Playing against real opponents is always  interesting! 

 Today, we will explain how to run in Custom Game mode  so that you can hone team battle skills with your friends! 

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image09.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Game instructions[/h1]

 [b]1. Select the "Custom game" tab on the top panel of the gaming globe. [/b]

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image13.png[/img]

[b]2. You will see the current list of private games created by other players.[/b]

You can join an existing game – filters will help you choose the best option. To join  an existing game, click "Join". Or you can create your own private game by clicking  "Сreate game". 

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image03.png[/img]

[b]3. You will see the window "Create private game". [/b]

[b]In it you'll be able to: [/b]
[list]  [*]Create a name and       password for the future private game.[/*]     [*]Set the number of       players: 1x1, 2x2 or 3x3.[/*]     [*]Select       a battle map.[/*]     [*]Set the maximum era for       units.[/*][/list]
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image10.png[/img]

[b]4. After the game is created, other players can join it.[/b]

You can invite your friends to join the new game by  sending them an invitation with the "Invite" button on the  "Contacts" tab (next to the chat tab).  

View of new private game 1x1: 

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image08.png[/img]

View of new private game 3x3: 

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image12.png[/img]

When you get the perfect detached unit for attack,  press "Attack". Your commander's icon will be in "Ready"  status. 

The private game will start when all players are ready  for battle. 

[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/DEVBLOGS/32/image11.png[/img]

And may the best man win! Good luck on the battlefields!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/235380/

notes.title: “Dora” Mission!
notes.content:
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/UPDATES/Dora2.gif[/img]

[h1]Comrades, it’s the moment we’ve all been waiting for: the “Dora” Deluxe Mission is finally here! In this scenario you will get to see the most massive and terrifying weapon of World War II.[/h1]

“Dora”, a super-heavy railway  artillery system, struck terror into the hearts of Germany's enemies – now you  can witness its combat power for yourself! 

 Not one, but two locomotives  and two parallel sets of railway tracks were necessary to move this giant. It  took two weeks to prepare “Dora” for firing, and the reload time was 20-30  minutes. The crater diameter after a shell explosion was about 10 m, and its  shells were able to punch through up to 9 m of reinforced concrete. Several  hundred people were needed to maintain this juggernaut – more than 2,500 if counting  its security and air defense. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/784d38f8a8e8a5c65b6454ab3255ecd236a40adf.png[/img]

[h1]The gun was first used during the siege of Sevastopol.   [/h1]

After the battle in Crimea, “Dora”  was moved to the railway station of Taizy near Leningrad. Plans were to send one  more artillery system there for the shelling of the city and the naval base. Later,  in September 1944, “Dora” was used in the suppression of the Warsaw Uprising.

 The mission takes place around  the railway station of Taizy near Leningrad. Dora was placed and ready to fire.  One of the best German gunners, Georg von Küchler, was in charge of the  operation. The command had no doubt about his ability to effectively utilize the  firepower of “Dora”, but the Red Army offensive deprived the Germans of the  opportunity to use their supergun in battle. When the blockade of Leningrad was  first broken in 1943, “Dora” was quickly evacuated to the German rear to avoid  its capture by Soviet troops. And that’s how the famous gun’s war on the  Eastern Front came to its inglorious end.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/43b90726ad1d16750eff56b8efa021b2e062dc2a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Playing for the Germans you  will have to evacuate “Dora” under heavy fire from Soviet troops.[/h1]

But it’s not all that simple: the  railway line is partially blocked by another train. To solve this problem you  will need to repair the side track and move the obstruction there. Repair brigades  will be working in difficult conditions under constant pressure from the Soviet  infantry squads. Your task is to protect the  workers so they can restore the track as soon as possible. Once the railway  line is restored and the locomotives start pulling “Dora”, the Soviet troops  will commence airstrikes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/a70340501caea375ca9d1fbfa97bf97928077550.jpg[/img]

 As the Luftwaffe cannot provide support when under  fire from Soviet anti-aircraft guns, it’s very important to destroy or capture  them. If you succeed, you will be able to call in air support. The airstrikes  are not the only difficulty you’ll encounter – the enemy Tank Destroyers and  paratrooper squads will go out of their way to get their hands on “Dora”, but wise  placement of your squads will allow you to reach your destination and evacuate  the gun to the rear.

 Fight tooth and nail and do  not let the Soviet troops seize this super powerful gun! Time is of the  essence, the enemy is coming! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/366650/

To receive your prizes, all players mentioned above need to send a personal message to the project community manager on the same site where the set of bark phrases was submitted – on

notes.title: New Year event!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/fd6910611e22a8387ac3f943a292238daef2f933.jpg[/img]

Good day to you, comrades!

The New Year is fast approaching with only a few days left, and we are all preparing presents for each other and for ourselves.
We have prepared two surprises for you: a new map for skirmish mode, which you have all been waiting for, as well as a funny gaming event, which is related to the New Year.

Let’s start with the best news first :)
[h1]The new map is called Castle Ruins. [/h1]
It’s a snowy region in the north of France, in the Ardennes mountains near Belgium. A spectacular castle used to stand here, but after past assaults by different nations, only the ruins are left. But even they capture the imagination with their size and former greatness. According to the architect’s plans, the castle was surrounded by a water-filled moat, with bridges and secret passageways leading into the building. These have all been preserved. The large number of assault routes will provide tactical variety to the skirmishes on this map.

One of the features of this map is the presence of towers. These fortifications provide a useful vantage point for the platoons, as well as being very reliable and hard to destroy. The towers are not located near the control points, but the soldiers occupying them can shoot over strategically important areas.

There has been fighting in this region in the past. You can see the evidence in the various weapons left by the castle, whose occupation will help you to win.
We recommend actively using the infantry during fighting on this map. Send your fighters to take the weapons and the towers, and victory will be as good as yours!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/0ab91ce43e5d8b23e0ab3171bf23351b1dfcf5d2.png[/img]

Over the holidays, you will find the new map festively decorated – you will be surrounded by beautiful Christmas trees, and General Winter will be waiting for you under the biggest tree. He is completely harmless, although we’ll admit that we wanted to give him a grenade launcher so that he could defend himself if necessary :)

Grandfather hasn’t come alone but with presents. You can find out what’s in them by joining the game.

[h1]The New Year has affected not only the map but also the troops in the game. We have introduced a special support during the festive season! Can you guess who it is?[/h1]

You can summon General Winter himself to help you! The harmless old man makes a pretty good scout, and you can also summon as many greybeards as you like, but remember that reloading the support takes one minute. Can you imagine a whole squad of Generals Winter, who shock the enemy with their appearance? Can you? Unfortunately, war is no place for suspicious-looking types – the poor grandfathers will be gunned down :( You better be quick to save  them  if  they are  spotted!
The New Year decorations and support won’t remain in the game for long, so don’t wait to experience the positive emotions when you test them in battle. 

By the way, during the festive season, you will get this map every time you log into the skirmish!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/ef5d6e84e36ca2a70fa6c22bb469f0fb862959a2.png[/img]

[i]On behalf of the development team at Blitzkrieg 3, we wish you a Happy New Year and all the best for the future! To health, happiness and victory! :)[/i]

Can you imagine a whole squad of Generals Winter, who shock the enemy with their appearance? Can you? Unfortunately, war is no place for suspicious-looking types – the poor grandfathers will be gunned down :( You better be quick to save  them  if  they are  spotted!
The New Year decorations and support won’t remain in the game for long, so don’t wait to experience the positive emotions when you test them in battle. 

By the way, during the festive season, you will get this map every time you log into the skirmish!

[i]On behalf of the development team at Blitzkrieg 3, we wish you a Happy New Year and all the best for the future! To health, happiness and victory! :)[/i]

notes.title: Liberate Bastogne!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/26eaf0cce99e5e9f7109127210710dbf38408ac9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greetings, officers! Here is the last Allies story mission![/h1]

[h1]You will be taking part in the heroic Siege of Bastogne![/h1]

For a successful offensive after the capture of Antwerp, the Germans had to occupy all the roads in Ardennes. All the main roads converged on the small town of Bastogne, which is why control of its crossroads was vital for both sides. The Allied forces in the Bastogne area held up the German advance, but there was no breakthrough in sight.

Due to a prolonged bout of bad weather, Allied aviation was virtually paralyzed, and the Germans were able to move 70 km forward. The morale among the British and American soldiers was at its lowest. The situation was worsened by the presence of intruders in their midst.     

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/a69b588492bc1c1ee58a5ba00cfc36fb587e85f8.jpg[/img]

In the first stage, you as the Commander of Special Operations, will have to apply all your knowledge and expertise to the task of improving your army's morale – find the saboteurs that are undermining the already broken spirit of the soldiers and eliminate the enemy mobile MLRS terrorising the area. Bring hope back to your men and thwart the enemy's plans to avoid imminent defeat!

But be careful! If you destroy the enemy without interrogating them first, you will be charged with violating regulations and court-martialed. Proceed with caution and maximum efficiency. Don't let the Germans rob you of this strategically important victory!
Stay vigilant, as the Germans have even disguised their vehicles to look like yours:

Luckily for all the Allied forces in Bastogne, December the 23rd dawns bright and fair. Planes drop long-awaited supplies. Fierce battles for provisions and ammunition await you since the enemy also wants to restock.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/5e82f072c26bad06397a7ca98f761e42245deaf2.jpg[/img]

The size and strength of your army will depend on how many supplies you manage to collect. Send the maximum number of soldiers into battle, and do not let the enemy grow even stronger!
Battles continue on all fronts, and you are entrusted with the formidable task of moving the wounded and shell-shocked out of the combat zone. You'll have to not only destroy the enemy, but also protect hundreds of innocent lives. Given enough strength and skills, you can save the inhabitants of the Noville village from the vicious German.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/70c5cf287c65d6d36d6564f0c2d781cb9de60702.jpg[/img]

A serious battle awaits you after the evacuation of civilians. You will need to retake Noville, which has either been captured by the Germans or is barely holding on (depending on your actions within the mission)! The Germans have dug in well, yet it is not so much the protection of the village but the course of the whole war that is at stake now – if the Germans break through, the Western Front could be lost. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/184b920f7665687bc4341c1acee9e4ff2db9f463.jpg[/img]

Stop the German forces! Don't let the enemy emerge victorious from this battle. 

Fight as fiercely as the soldiers of the Easy Company, the legendary "Band of Brothers". Do not give up but rather tell the Germans, "Us surrender? Aw, nuts!" 

[i]P.S. That's exactly what Anthony McAuliffe, commander of the U.S. 101st Airborne Division, said when the Germans offered the Allies to surrender. [/i]

notes.title: New PvP map!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/1afb406865f2fa3694cac4ae61fd54b85937b83d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/2c2a849fc8d3db1f47a8be886d442f8f0841b4b2.jpg[/img]

•    Introducing the final Allies mission – the Siege of Bastogne!*
•    The Deluxe Edition mission Dora has been added!*
(this scenario is available if you are playing on the side of Germany)
•    A new type of mission is added: the mini-mission!

They are faster and more straightforward than all the others in the game. 
They are very easy to find as they are marked with blue and white icons on the globe (Search and Rescue, Battle of Smolensk).

[h1]Two new additional missions and 10 mini-missions have arrived![/h1]

[h1]The Breath of Freedom mission[/h1]
The new mission Breath of Freedom will appeal to the true commanders with its complexity and valuable prizes! If you win, you will receive the SU-100Y and SU-14!
You will have to rescue the captured prisoners in far from easy conditions, so don’t expect a painless victory.

[h1]The Search and Rescue and An Unexpected Encounter missions[/h1]
These two missions are closely linked, moreover, there will be two scenarios taking place on the same map, one for each side of the conflict. If you’re playing for the USSR, you will need to capture a German soldier and question him, all the while protecting the local populace from attacks by the Third Reich. If you’re playing for the Axis, you will be dealing with the consequences of the first storyline.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/4e80796900098cc6d8afe6895bb3ac516844bb75.jpg[/img]

A new map has been added to the game for skirmish mode, called Castle Ruins, and the probability of getting it during the New Year holidays is 100%!
On New Year’s Eve, this map will be decorated for the festive season, with Christmas trees as well as the General Winter! There will be valuable presents waiting for you under the Christmas trees, so don’t forget to open them! The map will stay with us after the New Year, but General Winter will take the trees and leave until the next festive season. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/80645f13e9b17382f37d0e66db70b726a6473842.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the holidays, we’re temporarily introducing a new support character, General Winter. Despite their vulnerability, they can become excellent intelligence officers. Indeed, who would suspect that a bearded old man might be a brave general? By summoning one General Winter after another, you can create a whole holiday platoon.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/2f6621be54c9a92e3f77f7cf49478333c606f7b5.jpg[/img]

Game chat is now available both at the base and during battles. A friends list has also been added!
Please note that adding to the list is unilateral. The person that you add to your friends list will not receive any information, including an invite to add you to their friends list in return.
We have also introduced teams. You can now invite one or two friends to your group and play in 2x2 or 3x3 modes. :) 
Furthermore, when you fight in the same battles, you will have access to the team chat! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/3e0dee9ab42d0849e96be0f9b95debdb85222dfa.jpg[/img]

Your Game is an agreed fight with chosen allies and opponents. For example, if there are four of you, you can split into two teams, A and B, and fight each other! Prizes are not awarded for winning in these matches.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/f65e03ba86d9dec0c552e8672086f7e3eadd2a3e.jpg[/img]

•    Awards given for completing the missions are now displayed more are displayed more clearly!
•    Large infantry platoons are now better positioned in fortifications.
•    The balance has undergone the following changes: 
1) Increased damage from tank coaxial guns.
2) Unit experience has been reworked. Now they will receive a significant addition to their profile abilities when they reach levels 3, 6 and 10. 

[i]* - We will tell you about these missions in a separate post, very soon! :) [/i]
